newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight narrower, one-week down.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight narrower, one-week down.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed in a very liquid private-sector market on Tuesday because of repos, to between 10 and 10-1/8 percent from Monday's 9-7/8 to 10-5/16 percent, bankers said.
One-week rates fell, to a range of between 10 and 10-3/16 percent against a range of 10-1/4 to 10-3/8 percent on Monday, they added.
The market was liquid because of two repo offers of 500 million pounds ($147 million) each, one on Sunday and one last week, the bankers said. Both are valid until next Thursday.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
